tonight.headline: Wilson's protocol decides the FLEX — put Kamara in now
body: Bad news first. Garrett Wilson missed Wednesday and Thursday in the concussion protocol and reports call a return doubtful; Kamara's back kept him to a limited Thursday; Tuten managed 8.9 on Thursday as Jacksonville's blowout handed the second half to Abdullah.

AVIATO lead 8.9 to 5.58 after Thursday but ESPN projects 115.9 to 124.6, a 45% chance. The one lever: the FLEX. Kamara (11.2) over Allgeier (9.3) — a coin flip the projection takes — unless Friday's report clears Wilson.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Talla Metralla start Joe Burrow, Jonathan Taylor, D'Andre Swift, Derrick Henry (5.6 Thursday) and Matthew Golden; Taylor faces the league's 3rd-softest run defence (Dallas). Your Monday pair, Allen and Jefferson, are the last word.

case.label: Falsified if

case.label: The FLEX as it stands
case.body: The owner moved Allgeier into the FLEX for Wilson at 23:57Z Thursday — the right idea on Wilson, the lower of the two backs. Kamara 11.2, Allgeier 9.3: a 1.9 gap, inside the coin-flip line, so the projection decides and no thesis is written.

case.label: Wilson
case.body: Concussion protocol, DNP Wednesday and Thursday, 'day to day' (Glenn); reports call a return doubtful (Fox 4 Nov; Sporting News/Yahoo 5 Nov). ESPN still projects 12.8 — that is the unpriced news. If Friday's report clears him with no designation, he goes in over Kamara instead.

case.label: Kamara's back
case.body: Rest-day DNP Wednesday, limited Thursday (Saints report 5 Nov). He plays at 12:00, Allgeier at 15:25, so if Kamara is on the 10:30 inactive list there is time to put Allgeier back.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Wilson plays and outscores Kamara (the open Kamara-over-Wilson entry, graded from the archive). Kamara versus Allgeier is a coin flip and is not graded.

case.label: The rule
case.body: The only reason Wilson sits is availability. A clean Friday (no designation, independent neurologist's clearance) removes it, and then the projection decides: 12.8 over Kamara's 11.2.

case.label: The matchup
case.body: At Kansas City, 2nd-toughest on receivers (StatChasers 4 Nov); KC -10, total 47.5 (VegasInsider 5 Nov).

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: He is cleared, starts, and Kamara outscores him (archive).

whatWentWrong.title: The Wilson fix went to Allgeier, not Kamara
whatWentWrong.lead: Benching Wilson was right; the FLEX went to the lower-projected back.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Thursday's 16:00 brief said Kamara into Wilson's FLEX. At 23:57Z the owner moved Allgeier in instead, after Kamara left the RB slot for Tuten.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Do-first 1: one swap, Kamara for Allgeier. The gap is 1.9 — small, but free.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Allgeier was moved in because of news this brief cannot see about Kamara's back — Friday's report will say.

lineupCheck.verdict: The projection lineup starts Wilson over Allgeier (+3.5), but Wilson's two DNPs in the concussion protocol are unpriced; without him the FLEX is Kamara 11.2 against Allgeier 9.3, a coin flip the projection takes — put Kamara in.

moves.reason: Unpriced availability news: Wilson DNP Wednesday and Thursday in the concussion protocol, 'day to day', a return called doubtful (Fox 4 Nov; Sporting News/Yahoo 5 Nov 19:08Z); ESPN still projects a full game. With Wilson out, Kamara over Allgeier is a 1.9 coin flip that goes to the projection — no thesis on that part.
